title: Tech News with G. Dai — Episode 10
intro: Namaste! Welcome to episode ten of Tech News with G. Dai. Five stories you need to know today. And the last one is a tiny A-I that fits on your phone!

stories.headline: Tesla to stop making Cybertruck
stories.vo: Big end for a famous truck! Elon Musk says Tesla will stop making the Cybertruck in twenty twenty seven. The space will make more Cybercab robotaxis. Tesla is shifting its focus to A-I and robots.

stories.headline: Vianet promises same-day fixes
stories.vo: Slow internet at home? Vianet has launched a service called Today's Problem, Fix Today. Report an issue before five P-M, and it gets priority for the same day, by remote help or a visiting technician.

stories.headline: WorldLink leads Nepal fiber race
stories.vo: Who rules Nepal's fiber internet? N-T-A data for Ashoj shows about three point five seven million fiber users. World-Link leads with over one point one two million. Vianet is second, and Nepal Telecom is fourth.

stories.headline: Serve Robotics sells robot AI tools
stories.vo: Robots need brains in the cloud! Serve Robotics, known for sidewalk delivery robots, launched Physical A-I Services. Its Serve Link tool connects robots to data-center A-I, so they need less computing onboard.

stories.headline: A 32MB voice AI runs offline

stat.label: size of Underdog's Woof speech model

stories.vo: Here's a surprise! A startup called Underdog made Woof, a text-to-speech model of just thirty one point seven M-B. It runs in your browser, even without internet. Small A-I like this could power phone apps.

outro: That's your tech brief for today. Would you use an A-I voice that works offline? Tell me in the comments, and follow G. Robotics so you never miss tomorrow's brief.
caption:
Tesla says the Cybertruck is ending in 2027. Did you ever want one? 🚗

1️⃣ 🚗 Tesla to stop making Cybertruck
2️⃣ 🇳🇵 Vianet promises same-day fixes
3️⃣ 🌐 WorldLink leads Nepal fiber race
4️⃣ 🤖 Serve Robotics sells robot AI tools
5️⃣ 🎙️ A 32MB voice AI runs offline

Which story surprised you most? Tell us in the comments!

G. Dai is an AI-generated presenter.
Sources: TechCrunch, CBS News, NepaliTelecom
